title: Multimodal Support in Gen AI Studio Playground
assumptions: Source was the local rfe-snapshot.md (Jira not reachable); the snapshot's strategy scope (input only, text output) supersedes the original RFE's audio output, microphone, multi-image and comparison asks.
Persona catalog (knowledge/personas/catalog.yaml) is not present in this plugin install; personas ai-engineer and ai-platform-admin are inferred.
File size limit shown as 10 MB for image and audio (proposed default pending PM confirmation).

The ASR capability flag UX is not yet designed; prototyped as an 'Edit capabilities' modal with a 'Transcription endpoint (ASR)' checkbox and a teal label in the AI asset endpoints table. Catalog modality tags are shown read only (custom capability tagging is out of scope).
Audio input control is shown for models tagged audio-asr; models without modality tags show text input only. Inaccurate tags surface as an inference-time error (model-rejected-input scenario).
The one-file-per-conversation limit is communicated with persistent helper text plus an inline warning on a second attempt; New chat clears the limit.
Image/audio controls are buttons that open the native file picker; client-side validation (0 bytes, MIME allowlist, 10 MB) runs before any upload and is functional in the prototype.
Model names (Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen2.5-Omni, granite-3.3, gemma-3, whisper-large-v3, OpenAI whisper-1) and responses are illustrative mock data.
ASR flag changes on the AI asset endpoints page are not persisted to the Playground page in this standalone prototype; use scenarios to see each end state.
